sources.name: surfboardv2ray
sources.notes: Phase 1b KEEP. FA operator-direct Telegram channel via public web preview; the 1b report gives no pinned sub URL, so the preview feed is used (revisit if a pinned sub link is published). VOLATILITY (audit 2026-11-20): volatile — Telegram preview window spans only ~4.7 h; 35.7% eligible-key retention over ~8 h. Demoted to discovery/volatile class; recovery relies on snapshot pinning + URI cache.

sources.name: bahemmat-collector
sources.notes: Phase 1b KEEP (dedup-critical). FA Telegram-channel collector; broadest protocol spread but 39.5% host overlap with the Phase 1 family. VOLATILITY (audit 2026-11-20): volatile — list flips between full/partial scrape states sub-hourly (key survival ~0.35 @1 h); ~30% stable family core. Demoted to discovery/volatile class; recovery relies on snapshot pinning + URI cache.

sources.name: radikal-verified
sources.notes: Plan Rev.2 R1 (wolf's order, 2026-11-20): 0xRadikal/Free-v2ray-Configs verified tier as a flagged upstream. VERIFIED-CORPUS class, not a list: the file is a rotating freshly-verified set (exact-key persistence 0.572 @24h, R0) — that figure does NOT make its configs trusted; every config re-enters the full Gate 1-3 pipeline, pinning and tier rules, and its ordering is never inherited (fronting-first re-ranking is mandatory). Known biases to counter at composition: REALITY/TCP-heavy (WS ~6%), port 443 ~42%, ~37% US. Never ingest its all/ tier (~87% dead/flaky). Yield and Gate-3 contribution are tracked by governance (R1) and the weekly survival audit (Phase D).

sources.name: alireza-collector
sources.notes: Supply-bias adoption (corrected programme, 2026-11-20): trialled for CF-fronted/profile supply. Measured at adoption: 2,400 unique keys in one fetch (largest single supply), field-profile share 0.172 and classes-0/1 share 0.142 — ~2.4x the profile share of the best list incumbent (radikal 0.072, NoMoreWalls 0.066, ermaozi 0.072). Survival (gh mode): 0.64 @1h / 0.34 @24h — a rotating-list class source like bahemmat, hence volatility=volatile; every config re-enters the full Gate 1-3 pipeline and no ordering is inherited. Governance tracks its yield; the weekly survival audit judges it.

sources.name: jafar-cf
sources.notes: Supply-bias adoption (corrected programme, 2026-11-20): predominantly CF-fronted collection — measured at adoption: 9 of 12 unique keys are class 0 (CF-anycast-IP WS+TLS), classes-0/1 share 0.75, profile share 0.75 (the densest profile source measured). Tiny volume by design (upstream tests before publishing, ~20-min cadence); survival 0.95 @1h / 0.43 @24h on a small base. Its jafar_ultimate.txt sibling measured 0 valid keys and was NOT adopted. Full pipeline applies; governance tracks yield.
